title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：AI融资潮后，关注回报路径而非资本规模
speaker: Beth Wong

segments.en: I think within the AI space, you shouldn't see a lot of fundraising, whether it's in the credit space and now in the equity space. And I think that really changes, and what we have seen since July, is that change in market narrative of the market, just not necessarily focusing on building AI, but also what companies would be able to be very disciplined in terms of having that monetization roadmap and having that return on investment roadmap in terms of the investment that they have built on.
segments.zh: 我认为在AI领域，你会看到大量融资，无论是在信贷领域还是现在的权益领域。自7月以来，市场叙事发生了变化，不再仅仅关注建设AI，还关注公司是否有纪律性地规划变现路径和回报路径。

segments.en: So this, I think, for us investors, would be very focusing on rather than just how much capital there is, how much money that companies are investing on AI.
segments.zh: 所以对我们来说，重点不是资本有多少，而是公司投入了多少资金在AI上。

segments.en: You know, a big question now with more choices in the AI story, whether that's to your point. There's a broadening out that there are more names now to consider. Where do we get that allocation? In other words, on average, let's say, an average investor profile, what is the appropriate exposure to AI and AI adjacent sectors? How much is too much?
segments.zh: 现在AI故事有了更多选择，范围扩大，有更多标的可以考虑。我们该如何配置？对于普通投资者，AI及相邻行业的合适敞口是多少？多少算过多？
